ns0:problem.ns0:para: Determine whether the graph is the graph of a function. Explain your answer.

ns0:media.alt: The figure has a cube function graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The y-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The curved line goes through the points (negative 1, 1), (0, 2), and (1, 3).
